summary: IPC Alternative Real Estate Income Trust filed an 8-K solely to announce an ordinary monthly cash distribution to stockholders of record as of August 31, 2026. The board authorized gross distributions of $0.1042 per share across Class T, D, I, and X-1 common stock, with net amounts after fees ranging from $0.0872 to $0.1042. No shares of Class S, X-2, or A were outstanding. Payments are scheduled on or about September 3, 2026, in cash or through the distribution reinvestment plan. This routine distribution notice does not constitute a special situation; no extraordinary transaction or event is involved.
